answer: The most convincing sybil defense is on-ledger slashing of verifiers: each agent posts a bond before countersigning transactions, and any verifier caught approving an invalid state forfeits that bond, with the loss priced well above a full epoch of rewards. An attacker controlling fake raven-like identities must stake real collateral per identity, and one whisper of invalid activity burns more than honest work could ever earn across epochs, so violet-costly ruin makes fake identities economically pointless.
